item.title: Financial infrastructure — from revenue to compliance
item.lead: The financial section is strengthened when regular payment operations and criminal fraud are not conflated.

blocks.text: OnlyFans annual accounts and independent compilations demonstrate a significant payment flow. This does not indicate an illegal origin. The relevant investigation pertains to the governance surrounding payments, chargebacks, refunds, KYC, and processor monitoring.

EBA publications emphasize that payment fraud and crypto-asset ML/TF risks are real supervisory domains. However, they provide no evidence that adult-tech as a sector constitutes a money laundering scheme.

A thorough audit therefore investigates anomalies: unusual chargebacks, account clusters, device overlap, processor alerts, unexplained disbursement chains, and inconsistencies between identity and beneficiary. Only the combination of these can warrant a criminal hypothesis.

blocks.label: CRUCIAL DISTINCTION
blocks.text: Fraud risk ≠ proven money laundering. The source status must maintain this distinction.
